description: The tactician's closed vocabulary (Plan 31 Task 11, variant T; the proposal rebuild-proposal-model-tactician.md section 4): one answer is one JSON object {play, <its args>, bound, why} and nothing else. Every arg is a label the view lists or a closed enum; there is no free-text field (ruling P28-K). Read by plays.py, which renders it into the system prompt and validates answers against it with a stdlib walk.

labels.zombie: Z<n>: a zombie of the view's `zombies` list
labels.refuge: D<n> (a door of the view's `doors` list) or B<id> (a building of the view's `buildings` list), the retreat's named filter
labels.place: B<id> or D<n>: a building or a door the view lists
labels.building: B<id>: a building of the view's `buildings` list
labels.part: P<i>: a body part of the view's `body.parts` list

fight.description: Take the zombie in the combat stance and kill it: the melee reflex presses, stomps and finishes; a standing zombie inside the swing radius is met in any play.

kite.description: Hold the stance facing the zombie and backpedal toward a named refuge (or `stance` to backpedal with none), never turning the back; it ends when the zombie is alone in danger range (then fight it), at the refuge, or after a few seconds.

avoid.description: Leave a group before it arrives: walk (sneaking past zombies that have not noticed) to a named refuge and shelter there.

dress.description: Stop and dress a bleeding part: a held bandage, a rag, or rip a garment for a rag first.

loot.description: Go into the building and loot it for the want.

travel.description: Walk to a building or door (sneaking near zombies that have not noticed); `explore` only when no building is listed: the goal layer walks to the unexplored edge.

shelter.description: Go into the building and close its door behind you.
